lines.zh: 我在你身后的矿道里走。
lines.en: I walk the tunnel behind you.

lines.zh: 我的脚步有声音，身体却没有。
lines.en: My steps make sound; my body doesn't.
I follow the path you dug.
My shadow sways on the wall.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和你的重合在一起。
lines.en: My footsteps fall exactly where yours do.

lines.zh: 碎石在我脚下响了一下。
我一直保持同样的距离。
lines.en: I keep exactly the same distance.
My name floats in the dark.
I walk slowly, as if waiting.
I stand and look at the wall.
My model is slightly out of place.
My arms are as thick as yours.
I stand and don't move for a long time.
There's a place I can't see.
I lift my face to your lamp.

lines.zh: 我的名字和你认识的人一样。
lines.en: My name looks like someone you know.
I'm in front of you and you're still searching.
I'm a little taller than you.
I don't intend to say anything.

lines.zh: 火把在你手里晃得厉害。
lines.en: The torch shakes badly in your hand.

lines.zh: 这间石室，容不下第三个人。
lines.en: This stone room has no room for a third.
I take one step forward, slowly.

lines.zh: 你背靠着石壁，退不动了。
lines.en: Your back is against the cave wall; there's nowhere left to go.
My eyes are the same as yours.
I'm waiting for you to speak.
Don't look at the shadow behind me.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，动作卡住了。
lines.en: I step back; my movement catches.

lines.zh: 这一下让我显出了轮廓。

lines.en: I made no sound at all.

lines.zh: 你站哪块石头上，我记住了。
lines.en: Which stone you stood on — I remember.
Don't put it in your pack.
Give it and I'll step back.
The tunnel wall presses us together.
I step back to let you pass.
We brush past each other; neither makes a sound.
There's another empty shell in the tunnel.
Our names both look like people's.
We turn our heads at the same moment.
Her arm rests on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们一起往前走了一步。
lines.en: We take one step forward together.
Her face blurs for a moment.

lines.zh: 我们守在这条矿道两头。
lines.en: We keep to both ends of this tunnel.
It drops to the floor; I never caught it.

lines.zh: 我试着握住，掌心是空的。
lines.en: I try to grip it; my palm closes on nothing.
This is the piece you dropped.
I keep it closed in my hand.

lines.zh: 我只是站在那里，看着你。
lines.en: I only stand there, watching you.
I've taken it, and I'm still here.
My hand rests on the stone.
There's only one way through here.
One layer of stone between us.
I walk the pits you dug.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和你的对不上。

lines.en: I stop at the end of it.
I don't breathe; I'm only copying you.
I reach out and pass through your shoulder.
I come close to your ear.

lines.zh: 我的手指碰到你的脖子。

lines.en: My fist comes down and meets only air.

lines.zh: 我站在你原来站的地方。

lines.en: You look back and see only shadow.

lines.zh: 矿道深处多了一点声音。
lines.en: A small sound appears deep in the tunnel.

lines.zh: 一个像玩家的人站在那儿。

lines.en: A name hangs in the tunnel air.

lines.zh: 你刚才是不是看见谁了？

lines.en: I walk out of the stone.
The light dims by one step.

lines.zh: 我站在火把照不到的地方。
lines.en: I stand where the torch doesn't reach.

lines.zh: 洞里有了第二个呼吸声。
lines.en: A second breath joins the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里迈出第一步。
lines.en: I take my first step out of the dark.

lines.zh: 洞壁上先多出一道女人轮廓。
lines.en: A woman's outline appears on the cave wall first.
I stop and wait for you to turn.

lines.zh: 石头缝里有东西在看我。
lines.en: Something in the rock seam watches me.
Now there are two of us here.

lines.zh: 火光穿过我，我亮了一下。
lines.en: Firelight passes through me; I glow.

lines.zh: 我落地时姿势不对，骨头错位。
lines.en: I land wrong; my bones sit crooked.
Water floods in and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 爆风把我吹散，又聚回来。
lines.en: The blast scatters me and I gather again.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，钉在后面的石上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and sticks in stone.
I haven't eaten in a very long time.

lines.zh: 雷光把矿道照白了，我也白了。
lines.en: Lightning whitens the tunnel, and me.
I've been falling for a long while.
